name: private-company-graph-rag
description: Multi-tenant enterprise Hybrid Graph RAG assistant

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @graphrag/api" "npm run dev -w @graphrag/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @graphrag/api && npm run build -w @graphrag/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @graphrag/api && npm run typecheck -w @graphrag/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @graphrag/api && npm run lint -w @graphrag/web
